두번째 사슬은 분홍색과 노란색으로 칠합니다.\n두 색 중 한 색만 3입니:
Color the second chain pink and yellow.

Neither chain alone removes any note.
Let's link the two chains.
파란 칸과 분홍 칸은 같은 박스에서 겹칩니다.\n약한 연결이라서 둘 다:
A blue cell and a pink cell see each other in one box.
They are a weak link, so they can't both be 3.
경우 1: 파란 칸이 3이면 분홍 칸은 3이 아닙니다.\n그러면 노란 칸:
Case 1: If the blue cells are 3, the pink cells aren't.
Then the yellow cells are 3.
Note 3 is removed from the cells that see yellow.
경우 2: 파란 칸이 3이 아니면 초록 칸이 3입니다.\n초록 칸과 겹치:
Case 2: If the blue cells aren't 3, the green cells are.
Note 3 is removed from the cells that see green.
Either way, the green cells
or the yellow cells are 3.
So remove note 3 from every cell
that sees both green and yellow.
두 사슬이 두 색씩 칠해져 있습니다.\n두 사슬에서 서로 겹치는 두 칸을:
Each chain is colored in two colors.
Find and tap two cells, one from each chain,
that see each other.
That cell is outside the chains. Look among the chains' cells.
This cell doesn't see any cell of the other chain.
Right. Now tap the other chain's cell that sees it.
That cell is in the same chain. Look in the other chain.
That cell doesn't see the one you tapped first.

Now skip the two colors joined by the weak link.
Find and tap the note 3 that sees both of the other two colors.
Right. The two cells see each other, so they are a weak link.

Right. It sees both of the other colors, so note 3 is removed.
It sees the two colors joined by the weak link. Look at the other two.
1. Color each of the two strong-link chains
in two colors.
2. Check for two cells, one from each chain,
that see each other.
3. Remove that digit from the cells
that see both of the other two colors.
It colors two chains in many colors,
so it is called Multi-Coloring.
